The scores from the paths suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, though the exact mechanism of interaction remains to be fully elucidated. The observed pathway highlights a potential mechanism by which Salicylic Acid could influence Slc22a10, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct involvement of Salicylic Acid in the regulation of this transporter.
